resources.string: PAudio is running in the background and can apply your profile to your music apps.
PAudio is off. Your music plays without it. Turn it on to apply your profile.
Choose one way. The two modes are never active at the same time, because that would equalize your music twice.
PAudio attaches to each music app that announces its audio. It does not touch other sounds. Some apps do not announce themselves.

Processes the global audio mix. This approach is deprecated by Android and only works on some devices. Try it if PAudio says your device\'s audio system refused its effect, or your music app is not announcing itself.
Start PAudio after the phone restarts
Off by default. On Android 15 and later the system may not let PAudio start by itself after a restart. In that case PAudio shows a notification, \"Tap to start PAudio\", and starts when you tap it.
Used for new profiles. Existing profiles keep their own strength; change it on Home.
Personalized earphone sound, tuned to your hearing and your taste.

PAudio is not a medical device. These results are estimates for music listening only and are not a medical diagnosis. Phones and earphones can\'t be calibrated like clinical equipment, so hearing loss that is equal across all frequencies can\'t be detected. If you notice changes in your hearing, ringing, or pain, see a doctor or audiologist.
